name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
description: Huge steam-venting machines that betrayed Arcum.

description_citations.text: "Soldev". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Soldevi Steam Beasts attack and destroy the School, leaving Lat-Nam without a school of magic; survivors travel to the Institute of Arcane Study.
timeline.quote: the school was attacked by Soldevi Steam Beasts and destroyed.

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "School of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Soldevi machinists, Arcum among them, copy ancient artifact designs; the excavated war beasts and steam beasts go out of control and destroy Soldev.
timeline.quote: went out of control due to the meddling of the Soldevi Adnates and destroyed the city

citation.text: "Arcum Dagsson", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arcum sends all the steam beasts out to hunt for Varchild; they return to find Soldev falling to ruin.
timeline.quote: Finding nothing, they returned to Soldev only to find it falling to ruin.

citation.text: "Fall of Soldev", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: War beasts and steam beasts overwhelm the city until Jodah confronts Jaya.
timeline.quote: The city was quickly overwhelmed by the combined powers of the war beasts and the steam beasts

citation.text: "Fall of Soldev", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya sends war beasts and steam beasts to destroy the school.
timeline.quote: The War Beasts and the Steam Beasts immediately set about destroying the school
